Do I need a patch test?
For any colour, yes, and at least 48 hours before. It takes two minutes and we cannot colour without it.
What if I do not like it?
Tell us while you are still in the chair, or ring within a week. We will put it right and there is no charge for that.
Do you do men's cuts?
Yes, at the same prices — the time it takes is the time it takes.
